record.title: China publishes GB/Z 290-2026 guidance on AI-generated content in academic publishing
record.summary: China’s State Administration for Market Regulation and Standardization Administration announced on 4 November 2026 that they had approved 37 national standardization guidance technical documents, including GB/Z 290-2026, titled “Guidance on boundaries for use of AI-generated/synthetic content in academic publishing.” The National Standard Information Public Service Platform lists the document as current and gives its publication date as 30 October 2026. The announcement and catalogue establish the document’s issuance, title and status; the text’s provisions, adoption and effects were not assessed.
organizations: State Administration for Market Regulation of China
National Standard Information Public Service Platform

claims.label: NOT_ESTABLISHED

brief.importance_rationale: If the guidance is used in scholarly publishing, it could influence disclosure and editorial practice for AI-generated or synthetic content. This is a consequential but bounded policy development; the available evidence does not establish its clauses, adoption or effects.
limitations: The SAMR announcement and national standard catalogue prove issuance and listing, not the content or effect of the guidance.
No organizational adoption, enforcement, implementation, or measured outcome was inspected.
The standard’s approval/publication date is 30 October 2026; SAMR posted its announcement on 4 November 2026.
